content: No published term 'ratchet effect' for running-max reward denominators, but running-max/high-water-mark trackers are known to be non-stationary; RL practice favors running mean/std (RMS) normalization or EMA-based percentile trackers (DreamerV3) specifically because a true running max is outlier-sensitive and monotonically non-decreasing, which can permanently deflate reward after one extreme rollout.
